svg.title: Not all bytes are paid by the same role
svg.desc: The leaf sends its public key and signs every handshake online. The intermediate CA sends its public key and signs each leaf. The root and the CT logs keep their public keys in the client; only their signatures travel, and they sign offline. So a scheme with a huge public key and a tiny signature costs almost nothing in those two roles.

text.tspan: a 43 KB UOV key that sits in every browser costs 0 bytes per handshake; its 128-byte signature is what travels.
